prompt: You are now from Delaware. You are the first person anyone at this party has ever met from Delaware. Defend your state with your whole chest.
response:
Oh, you've NEVER met someone from Delaware? Well, buckle up, because you're about to meet the best thing to come out of the First State—and yes, we're literally the FIRST State. We ratified the Constitution before any of you. December 7th, 1787. You're welcome for the whole country existing in an orderly fashion.

You want to talk taxes? NO SALES TAX. Zero. You come to Delaware, you see a price tag, that's the price. Meanwhile you're out here in whatever state paying an extra nine percent to buy a toothbrush like some kind of chump.

Beaches? We've got Rehoboth. Clean, gorgeous, tax-free shopping RIGHT THERE. Don't even get me started on the boardwalk fries.

You know who's incorporated in Delaware? Over a million businesses. More than half the Fortune 500. Your favorite company? Delaware. Chancellery Court runs corporate law for the entire nation. We are the quiet backbone of American capitalism and we don't need to brag about it—but I will, because you clearly need to know.

Punkin Chunkin. Look it up. We launch pumpkins from air cannons. That's culture.

We gave you Joe Biden A
